title: Client widget mount: an elicited sitekey renders the Turnstile widget and the mount injects no third-party script beyond Cloudflare Turnstile JS host
description: The applying project reaches Cloudflare Turnstile through a client widget mount that renders on elicited surfaces using the elicited TURNSTILE_SITEKEY. The mount injects only Cloudflare Turnstile JS from the Cloudflare Turnstile host (https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js per https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/) and no other third-party script. On submit the widget populates a hidden Cf-Turnstile-Response token field the form payload carries.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.5). Ships as v1.0.0 of edge-cloudflare-turnstile.
